description: Microsoft Power Automate cloud flow REST API integration (Flow Management REST via api.flow.microsoft.com). Each declared cloud flow becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy. Ships with 5 ops + jobs (retrigger, cancel run, turn off, turn on, reconcile), an external-execution monitor sensor, an inbound-trigger sensor, and an hourly reconciliation schedule. Auth is Azure AD / Entra ID client-credentials OAuth2. demo_mode=true simulates the full REST API lifecycle on stdout so the whole component runs end-to-end with zero external dependencies (no M365 tenant needed).

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per Power Automate cloud flow + optional external source-table assets + 5 ops/jobs + 2 sensors + 1 schedule.
